STEP 1 - Scene: A hospital-style breakfast tray (tray number 3067) with orange juice, oatmeal/cereal, canned peach slices, a banana, butter/jam portions, and a separate plate with toast, eggs, muffin and avocado. The meal here is the tray with its bowls and glasses; the plate at right is a separate tray component, though it is part of the same breakfast, so I include the items on the near plate as well.

STEP 2 - Vessel: The main vessel is the rectangular tray (about 30 x 20 cm, treated as a dinner-plate-sized surface, area ~530 cm^2). Two bowls: cereal bowls ~15 cm (area ~177 cm^2). Right-hand plate ~20 cm (area ~314 cm^2) holding eggs, muffin, avocado. The toast plate is ~20 cm (area ~314 cm^2) and is treated as a separate vessel at the edge.

STEP 3 - Items: orange juice (two glasses), cooked oatmeal/cereal, canned peach slices, banana, two butter/spread portions, toast with fruit bread, fried eggs (two), muffin, avocado slices.

STEP 4 - Area (as share of the main tray, ~530 cm^2):
- Oatmeal bowl (~177 cm^2 bowl, food fills ~70%): ~24% of tray area
- Peach bowl (food ~60%): ~20%
- Banana: ~12%
- Juice glasses (~8 cm diameter each, two): ~6%
- Butter portions: ~2%
The near plate (eggs, muffin, avocado, ~314 cm^2) is ~50% of its own area; the toast plate is ~45% covered.

STEP 5-6 - Volume and grams (main tray items):
- Oatmeal: 127 cm^2 x 2 cm = 254 ml x 0.8 = 203 g
- Peaches: 106 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 159 ml x 0.6 = 95 g
- Banana: 64 cm^2 x 3 cm = 190 ml x 0.7 = 133 g (banana ~118 g whole, use 120 g)
- Orange juice: ~250 ml total x 1.0 = 250 g
- Butter portions: 2 x 7 g = 14 g
- Fried eggs: 2 x ~50 g = 100 g (fried, ~0.9 density on plate)
- Toast (2-3 slices): ~80 g
- Muffin: ~55 g
- Avocado: ~35 g

STEP 7 - Energy (kcal per 100 g):
- Oatmeal (cooked): 70 kcal/100g → 203 g = 142 kcal
- Canned peaches: 60 kcal/100g → 95 g = 57 kcal
- Banana: 89 kcal/100g → 120 g = 107 kcal
- Orange juice: 45 kcal/100g → 250 g = 113 kcal
- Butter: 717 kcal/100g → 14 g = 100 kcal
- Fried egg: 196 kcal/100g → 100 g = 196 kcal
- Toast (fruit/whole-grain): 265 kcal/100g → 80 g = 212 kcal
- Muffin: 350 kcal/100g → 55 g = 193 kcal
- Avocado: 160 kcal/100g → 35 g = 56 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ~1,350 g? No, summing: 203+95+120+250+14+100+80+55+35 = 952 g, roughly 950 g. Energy: 142+57+107+113+100+196+212+193+56 = 1,176 kcal. This is plausible for a full, multi-component breakfast tray with two eggs, toast, muffin and juice.
